text:
michelle_prod: Heads-up: were opening a small H100 Dedicated alpha pool in us-east-1 (zones a+b). This is limited capacity for early adopters and migration pilots.

devin_infra: Alpha specifics: 12 H100s per zone, soft per-account cap = 6 GPUs/zone. To request >6, submit a quota request under \"Dedicated GPU - H100\" and include expected QPS + target dates. Expect ~3 business days for approval.

laura_sales: For deals in progress, do we have an incentive or guided support? Any migration credits?

michelle_prod: No broad credits for alpha. Priority allocation: (1) active Dedicated customers with commitments, (2) Enterprise SLO customers, (3) approved pilot partners. AMs can escalate exceptions through partner ops. See sales playbook in #sales-docs.

infra-bot: Pool telemetry snapshot: us-east-1a/b. p95 token-latency 42ms, p99 58ms, avg GPU util 61%, no node failures.

zach_ops: Note: kernel/driver updates scheduled Sun 2026-03-29 02:00-03:30 UTC. We'll perform staggered zone maintenance with cross-zone routing; single-zone placements may see brief evictions. Recommend customers enable cross-zone redundancy or use lower-tier families as fallback.

michelle_prod: Action items: (1) eng-infra add a depletion alert (pager if spare GPUs < 20% total) @devin_infra, (2) ops update fallback policy and playbook @zach_ops, (3) AMs begin outreach to top 20 Dedicated accounts now.

devin_infra: Adding alert and a CLI flag --prefer-zone for reservation API. Also adding reservation_type field: \"soft-hold\" vs \"hard-reserve\" to help prioritization.

michelle_prod: Internal docs: https://internal.redwood.com/docs/dedicated/h100-us-east (pricing, quota form, migration checklist, maintenance windows). Direct urgent capacity requests to support and tag #dedicated-ops.

laura_sales: Looping in AMs and partners. Will coordinate customer comms after 48h stabilty check.

zach_ops: I'll update #eng-oncall with the maintenance playbook. Ping me if you see unexpected evictions or routing issues.

michelle_prod: Thanks everyone :rocket: 

michelle_prod: We'll post an external customer note once the alpha proves stable for 48h. Questions or blocks, reply here or DM.
